widgets_values: 请详细准确描述图像的材质

This image shows a close-up of a piece of blue denim fabric. The texture of the denim is clearly visible, featuring the classic twill weave structure. The surface of the fabric exhibits a soft feel while maintaining a certain degree of stiffness. From the image, it can be seen that the fibers of the denim are tightly arranged, with even coloring, presenting a natural blue hue. This type of material is commonly used to make clothing such as jeans and jackets.

这张图片展示了一块蓝色牛仔布料的特写。牛仔布料的纹理清晰可见，具有经典的斜纹编织结构。布料表面呈现出一种柔软的质感，同时又具有一定的挺括性。从图像中可以看到，牛仔布料的纤维排列紧密，颜色均匀，呈现出一种自然的蓝色调。这种材质通常用于制作牛仔裤、夹克等服装。
